topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I don't know how to feel about this anymore. The thought of walking into that room, expecting smiles and laughter, only to find it empty and silent... It's a strange weight, isn't it? I tried to act like it didn't matter, like I understood why everyone's plans fell through. But the truth is, it's hard to shake off the disappointment. Maybe I should have seen it coming. People are busy, things get in the way. But part of me can't help wondering if it was ever really going to happen, or if it was just a nice idea that never stood a chance. Now I'm left here, with a weekend that's stretched out ahead of me, feeling like something's missing.
